The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To understand the complex concept of blockchain technology provided in the evidence, consider the analogy of a shared Google Doc versus a traditional notebook. In a traditional system, like a single notebook kept by one person, that person can easily erase or alter entries without anyone else knowing. However, blockchain is like a shared Google Doc that is copied onto thousands of computers simultaneously. If someone tries to change a line in their copy, the system checks against all the other copies. If the change doesn't match the majority, it is rejected. This ensures that the record remains unchangeable (immutable) and trustworthy because no single entity controls it (decentralized).
